Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 364, "heading": "IV BOUTEILLE D’ENCRE QUI NE RÉUSSIT QU’À BLANCHIR", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u364-r0062", "target": "— У меня в доме? Нет, — сказал он.", "source_sha256": "43fa9d5484d88e6979c062fc3c8eef600d24300768ae671b23de6417c48ca19a", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u364-r0062", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "9b5f2fbd3230773d1d9be500f4d57fe615b48214498727546a7949c464de5d52"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u364-r0063", "target": "Незнакомец, невозмутимый, смахнул локтем пыль со шляпы и продолжал:", "source_sha256": "7754ae90948076fa144f0582dccf5485be98dd7bbb75830bd91268e7263d63a1", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u364-r0063", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "8d783a8858b4773f06cd85c7ae2c738e5edfeaf1e01061675c9cde42dead4d66"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 5, "book": 9, "chapter": 4, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u364-r0064", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Assassin et voleur. Remarquez, monsieur le baron, que je ne parle pas ici de faits anciens, arriérés, caducs, qui peuvent être effacés par la prescription devant la loi et par le repentir devant Dieu. Je parle de faits récents, de faits actuels, de faits encore ignorés de la justice à cette heure. Je continue. Cet homme s’est glissé dans votre confiance, et presque dans votre famille, sous un faux nom. Je vais vous dire son nom vrai. Et vous le dire pour rien.", "sha256": "9eec0652876f77817c3752edbb78e1efd2dd82551d336827d868a585da2eafd8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’écoute.", "sha256": "69ecd244de9e2ddbe69841bb14c5f80aad3d68f31c160cf6c21dde9bfeb84f63", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il s’appelle Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "40c841d1ef2632b0563f1188f26578b2ea1d60fa97e497a2c5df27b2f0ed47a7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je le sais.", "sha256": "fe2310c329e9adf8364558b96da4abf6b483886867150a9723e93f15d5782784", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je vais vous dire, également pour rien, qui il est.", "sha256": "a2048d606d610098aa985d7753ad261d431a0c9c9888063c1ed91abf2eb31723", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Dites.", "sha256": "c577d1e9fcc79bc30b2c99e1d26d8eb41792106bd32dcbeeb8472488616efb0b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0070", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est un ancien forçat.", "sha256": "95f3498ee680dad88fd57e62b4413c3e5f1ad70aa7bc5c857eb50dfadd7d496a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je le sais.", "sha256": "fe2310c329e9adf8364558b96da4abf6b483886867150a9723e93f15d5782784", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous le savez depuis que j’ai eu l’honneur de vous le dire.", "sha256": "d54a55c4b20fa56624da4c3b4bd9b9d51f36119ec15f95852e4a3d433c1a9e1a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non. Je le savais auparavant.", "sha256": "9ca4913ec465ddecea9e0846dfe520bfbd6188b0ff6b18e8a6eae685101f628a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le ton froid de Marius, cette double réplique [[I]]je le sais[[/I]], son laconisme réfractaire au dialogue, remuèrent dans l’inconnu quelque colère sourde. Il décocha à la dérobée à Marius un regard furieux, tout de suite éteint. Si rapide qu’il fût, ce regard était de ceux qu’on reconnaît quand on les a vus une fois ; il n’échappa point à Marius. De certains flamboiements ne peuvent venir que de certaines âmes ; la prunelle, ce soupirail de la pensée, s’en embrase ; les lunettes ne cachent rien ; mettez donc une vitre à l’enfer.", "sha256": "d63753a1e201a99d351cba093d5753432fca05e91a158bbca3169f122300135e", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’inconnu reprit, en souriant :", "sha256": "9a99170d88cda07e82f6eff670f4b6ab4ad9b93c5341c307b73be5c6a31cdaec", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0076", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne me permets pas de démentir monsieur le baron. Dans tous les cas, vous devez voir que je suis renseigné. Maintenant ce que j’ai à vous apprendre n’est connu que de moi seul. Cela intéresse la fortune de madame la baronne. C’est un secret extraordinaire. Il est à vendre. C’est à vous que je l’offre d’abord. Bon marché. Vingt mille francs.", "sha256": "2d3f0671bbb0285655fc5f2a923021d58ea36a8b3f87befc2a1b6e73d751fcc8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0077", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je sais ce secret-là comme je sais les autres, dit Marius.", "sha256": "688db71aa2bd6a91a005678e58f4d732ee2bcd126afdacfd021ee254895a9770", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0078", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le personnage sentit le besoin de baisser un peu son prix :", "sha256": "91b5a6663265aedd602d3f7b6c453b1a80407a57eb2f5ec050acb977dec5ae4e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0079", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Monsieur le baron, mettez dix mille francs, et je parle.", "sha256": "cbff4120e8f925bd0651127d058287c47cdb88e9f5fc80a86e05e11f9f154435", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0080", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je vous répète que vous n’avez rien à m’apprendre. Je sais ce que vous voulez me dire.", "sha256": "ee556f9734eb486e83eb6a8b0810f3b5f7ad578d456616b9ac153d438abdf7f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0081", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il y eut dans l’œil de l’homme un nouvel éclair. Il s’écria :", "sha256": "8368ffe5926d70b59caca730b43fcfa058fb364d1fc72e574659acee77b1881b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0082", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il faut pourtant que je dîne aujourd’hui. C’est un secret extraordinaire, vous dis-je. Monsieur le baron, je vais parler. Je parle. Donnez-moi vingt francs.", "sha256": "ccd94aa711284efe3ff81bbc9f3afdf4a7c287af7bb8a4227d1897d00d22bb91", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0083", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius le regarda fixement :", "sha256": "5d9b52f3185987273d859f23079f058373e9e5d486a74d1239d08ed8c42df18a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0084", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je sais votre secret extraordinaire ; de même que je savais le nom de Jean Valjean, de même que je sais votre nom.", "sha256": "f000f419879f9947c868190f91df8225ad3d1bb3ed1f8ba1369e77792e297b01", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0085", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mon nom ?", "sha256": "65b2ba5d5b52f136e0af4955aebabf3d7f7d9ca0677c9c573c77262f8283be57", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0086", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0087", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ce n’est pas difficile, monsieur le baron. J’ai eu l’honneur de vous l’écrire et de vous le dire. Thénard.", "sha256": "267861966a7b8672b98b72ba9f51d1a1fba0d70a92d956ba59b016a3bed8acd9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0088", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Dier.", "sha256": "c5070b19c5ec72d2c74c97869610ad00a7691200f68be2e155c2ea4db60135ef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0089", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Hein ?", "sha256": "6f4905b437b6948a18583e0d14b52d7f2dd428bf5712d1870e5426b63921de17", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0090", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Thénardier.", "sha256": "29ac1ebab57d2f2e41808f354aaf01abe816402c168aebc5db4ecdb8d90f1e86", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0091", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui ça ?", "sha256": "19d16a41d6c30c41d4597a85eab840cb525fdbf6e468fcfb9cfc6dda54969fd2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0092", "tag": "prose", "text": "Dans le danger, le porc-épic se hérisse, le scarabée fait le mort, la vieille garde se forme en carré ; cet homme se mit à rire.", "sha256": "1eb6b5a0c4cac8e11e96f6c44fea872c60de9d332ce8796adddcfa0db36717bd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0093", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis il épousseta d’une chiquenaude un grain de poussière sur la manche de son habit.", "sha256": "d29a941bf6434b49d26c29eb94fdb3b8f2321e7c71b06fd2cbe8b1ba15b8c2a4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0094", "tag": "prose", "text": "Marius continua :", "sha256": "d0b089196a60a300ed0728b6a36fdd9d15332c203cbae0eb0a2174a3f9f74328", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u364-r0095", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous êtes aussi l’ouvrier Jondrette, le comédien Fabantou, le poëte Genflot, l’espagnol don Alvarès, et la femme Balizard.", "sha256": "4658dad1dc1eeb165b7b1e78e17ce662259364204b0cd03d4ef4d19b40724ecd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
